verdict.rationale: GitLab Duo Chat works inside the GitLab UI with access to your project's issues, merge requests, commits and CI/CD pipelines. It can search that data in natural language and give advice or propose solutions, and agents review code and suggest remediations (gitlab-docs-48, gitlab-docs-53, gitlab-docs-54, gitlab-docs-39, gitlab-docs-55, gitlab-docs-1). Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality, and documented proactive or dashboard-style AI insights beyond chat-driven Q&A and code review.
